title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns; CFO Colette Kress Named Interim CEO
summary: Nvidia's board announced November 12 that Jensen Huang resigned as President, CEO, and board member, effective immediately, following reports of an extramarital affair with a person alleged to have been recruited by China's intelligence services. CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while Nvidia conducts a permanent CEO search. Harvey C. Jones was appointed as the company's first-ever board chair. Market cap fell below $4 trillion for the first time since July 2025, down over 20% in the past month.
why: 全球最大AI芯片公司CEO突然离职，管理层过渡风险与地缘政治敏感性叠加，Q3财报将于11月17日公布，消息面雪上加霜；事件驱动波动率（IV）将显著抬升，建议财报前谨慎裸卖Put，可用Spread结构控制风险。

title: 美联储加息最新消息：CPI、PPI双超预期，12月加息已成市场主流预期
summary: 美国10月CPI月率涨0.4%（季调），核心CPI涨0.3%，均高于预期，美联储官员本周密集发出通胀担忧表态。多家机构（含美国银行）调整预测，将未来多次会议均纳入加息路径。另据报道，美联储公布2027年FOMC会议暂定日程。
why: 通胀韧性超预期与美联储鹰派预期明确叠加，实际利率将继续上行，对科技与消费板块持仓形成系统性估值压力；持有高隐含波动率期权头寸（Sell Put/Covered Call）短期受益但Delta敞口需要管理。

title: U.S. October PPI Climbs to Highest Annual Rate Since 2022
summary: The BLS released October Producer Price Index data on November 13, showing wholesale prices rose to their highest annual pace since 2022. The back-to-back inflation surprise—following the hot CPI on November 10—solidified market expectations for a December Fed rate hike and pushed U.S. equity indices lower.
why: PPI+CPI双超预期确认通胀重新抬头，对中长期利率路径产生上行压力，直接影响成长股估值折现率；若持有NVDA、GOOGL等高PE科技持仓，须重新审视利率风险敞口。

title: Jensen Huang's Resignation Revives Push to Tighten Chip Export Controls on China
summary: Three House committees are preparing legislation—including the AI Overwatch Act, Chip Security Act, and MATCH Act—to tighten AI chip exports to China in the wake of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation amid a foreign intelligence scandal. The Commerce Department is separately finalizing a rule restricting Chinese entities' remote access to advanced AI chips through overseas cloud data centers. The debate comes ahead of President Trump's planned APEC meeting with Xi Jinping. China has warned against new chip curbs.
why: 芯片管制收紧将压制中国AI企业计算能力获取，波及阿里云、腾讯云等云服务商；若Commerce远程访问规则落地，中国AI科技股（9988.HK、0700.HK等）将承受新一轮估值下调压力；关注特朗普-习近平APEC峰会（11月18-19日）可能的政策信号。

title: Nvidia Faces Congressional Summons, Class Action Lawsuits After Jensen Huang's Exit
summary: Three House committees sent a joint letter summoning former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang for a closed-door December 1 hearing on national security concerns. Multiple law firms have filed securities class-action lawsuits on behalf of investors. Morningstar cut its fair value estimate for NVDA. Q3 earnings are due November 17 after close; Nvidia has guided for approximately 106% annual revenue growth.
why: Congressional召唤+集体诉讼+CEO空缺三重压力下，NVDA期权隐含波动率（IV Rank）将维持高位；11月17日Q3财报为重要催化剂，建议用Strangle或Spread承接波动率溢价而非裸卖Put；若Q3业绩符合甚至超预期，存在事件驱动超卖反弹机会。

title: 阿里巴巴正式公告拟分拆平头哥赴港主板独立上市，9月已秘密递表
summary: 阿里巴巴（9988.HK）于11月10日公告，拟将全资芯片子公司平头哥半导体以H股方式在香港联交所主板独立上市，联交所已确认可进行分拆。平头哥于2026年9月11日以保密形式递交A1表格，分拆后阿里将保留多数控制权并继续合并报表。市场对估值预测分歧较大（200亿至620亿美元区间），仍需港交所上市委员会批准及中国证监会备案。公告后阿里股价因AI算力管制担忧持续承压，跌破100港元整数关。
why: 平头哥分拆有望让嵌在阿里云业务内的AI芯片价值独立显现，触发估值重估；但阿里目前同时面临美国AI算力访问管制新规的压力，股价跌破100港元整数关，短期承压。对BABA/9988.HK持仓者：分拆长期利好，但管制风险需按实际进展动态跟踪；Sell Put行权价建议设于100港元下方。
